[olist]
[*] Neutral Card+ Version!
[*] Challenge Node
[*] Undead Thief

notes.title: New Demo Gameplay stats.!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 👋

It's been a month since we launched our demo, and as always, we're back to share some exciting gameplay stats! But before that, let’s celebrate some awesome news about our game! 🎉

[h3][b]Northwind now has over 10,000 Wishlists
and more than 7,000 Demo Players! OMG! ːdazed_yetiː [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/c4ae484c390a748a4e9b53c3283e3c5db13111f0.png[/img]
[h3][b]Not to mention, 27 reviews! 🎉[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/05e34698a4dc4aa1b8536727d06bec525c2db6bd.png[/img]

This means so much to us as a small team! 💙 At first, we were a bit reluctant to share this data, but your incredible support has inspired us. We truly believe you’d enjoy celebrating this milestone with us!
Without you playing our game, joining the community, and providing us with valuable feedback, we wouldn’t have come this far. So, from the bottom of our hearts... Thank you! ❤️

[h3][b]Demo Gameplay Stats.[/b][/h3]
This time, we see some similarities with the previous stats on the most-picked cards, but what really changed is the winning deck strategy! The meta has definitely shifted due to the boss this time around.
So, we'll focus on analyzing the winning decks. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/d6227eda45e8691baf2cb0809385e19aebd05370.png[/img]

We can really see how you all are now playing more basic card combos and synergies, which makes perfect sense! Feel free to try out some of these cards and combos if you want to defeat the boss or take on Hazard 2!
[list]
[*][i]An interesting stat we found: [b]Basic Attack[/b] is the second most forged card while also being the most removed card using the Wandering Merchant’s service! ːsurprised_yetiː
[*]We're also noticing some fewer plays with [b]Eager Punch[/b] cards!
[*]One of the dev.: Initiate with Focus+ looks super awesome! How did we miss that?! ːlaughing_yetiː [/i][/list]We are aware that some players feel restricted by this boss's strategy, while others feel encouraged to build decks they wouldn’t have considered before—especially using basic cards.
We'll definitely look into this more! We believe one of the charms of having multiple bosses in Northwind is that each one's unique characteristics can push you to build something you never imagined, while still being flexible enough for you to defeat them with your own crafted deck!

[i](By the way, The Warlord was intended to be among the easiest bosses..
What are your thoughts? Do you find the challenge exciting, or does it discourage you from playing? 
Let us know!)[/i]

Link to our Previous Demo Gameplay Stats! (Back then, the boss was [b]Silverfangs[/b], not [b]The Warlord![/b])
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1476400/view/4193491470659656247?l=english

[h3]🔎 More Feedback & Suggestions We've Received:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix the Controls! – Selecting our character for some card effects feels weird. Why not auto-select or allow clicking on equipment directly if needed? 
[i][b]= We couldn't agree more! This is at the top of our fix list.
[/b][/i][*] More Juiciness, Animations, & Effects!
[i][b]= This is something we definitely want to improve! The level of "juiciness" depends on player expectations, but we'll do our best to enhance the experience as much as possible.[/b][/i]
[*] More Languages!
[i][b]= Yes! We plan to add more localization in the future. We’ll announce the supported languages soon!
[/b][/i][*] Content Feedback: – Card archetypes, Legacy Points, and Hazard Level progression don’t feel impactful enough.
[i][b]= We hear you! Since this is just a demo, we haven’t revealed all of our content yet, but your feedback has given us new ideas on how to improve progression. We hope you look forward to our Early Access Version![/b][/i][/list]
[b][h3]What’s Happening with the Demo and Early Access Version?[/h3]
[/b]Our current plan is to focus on the Early Access launch, which we’re aiming for in Q3 2025! 🎉
(We need to make it happen this year, seriously!) As for the demo, we plan to keep it live for a while—possibly until the Early Access release. However, we won’t be releasing any major updates, except for localization fixes and additional supported languages.

[b][h3]🔥 Pyrotech Playtesting[/h3]
[/b]We’ll probabyl need playtesters soon!
[b]If you’re interested in helping us balance her out, CLICK THE BANNER TO REGISTER! 👇👇👇
[/b][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfWUNm7WNznBpiwYkeQNXrnF9mKHJKQ0TPXBaeGie7JOJdKug/viewform?usp=dialog][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/0930ac4c78901b3d0e6c7f21a05cea92a4579c67.png[/img][/url]

[b][h3]Localization is about to start![/h3][/b]It's been delayed, but we think it will be ready by the end of March. We've been working hard to improve the quality-of-life (QoL) features for our localizers, and now the system is ready! 🎉 If you’d like to help us out, join our Discord! 💬
[b]CLICK THE BANNER TO JOIN! 👇👇👇[/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/rMEqbNhkha][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/0c228f03353fc8a98916c311d504f7113c91d7eb.png[/img]
[/url]
[h3]Thank you! Again, we truly appreciate your support. 🙏
[/h3]Slowly but surely, Northwind is becoming a game we never imagined we could create! The feedback we’ve received has been incredibly encouraging, pushing us to make it even better. 💙 Thank you!
— The Northwind Team at Barking Kitten Interactive 🐾

[h1]🎉 Our demo is now available! 🎉[/h1]

[h3]Check out our New Trailer![/h3]
[previewyoutube=LlsgrWDe32A;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New Boss Enters the Arena![/h3]
Being a monster-hunting roguelite deckbuilder means facing multiple bosses.
If you played our previous demo, you fought Silverfangs! But now, we’re introducing "The Warlord"! (Defeat him if you can...)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/5f4e9443505fbfc9b9cf3578ee71c5616faaa530.png[/img]

[h3]Revamped Map Nodes (Visual & Game Design)![/h3]

notes.title: New Update: Turn-Based Carnival
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 👋

[b]We’re honored to announce that we’ve been selected for the Turnbased Carnival! 🎉
[/b]If you enjoy turn-based games, check out the other incredible games featured there!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Acram/sale/turn-basedcarnival2024
][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/ff217742c2101d96f1167d8433ac38d86b13ced9.png[/img]
[/url]
We’d also like to take this opportunity to update you on our progress and share some of the exciting features we’ve been working on. Here are some highlights:

[h2]Countdown Token Replaces Rampage ⏳[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/536e8d0360583eeebc9d2321170a1d36177f555c.png[/img]

[h3][b]Is that a new UI!?[/b][/h3]
Yes! We’ve implemented a cleaner, more intuitive UI to make combat easier to understand.
Look forward to a brand new tutorial!

As for Rampage: Many players were confused about when Rampage would trigger...
Was it immediate or on the next turn??? We’ve replaced Rampage with a Countdown token, which triggers the special move once it reaches 0. [i](Not the official icon design)[/i]

[h3][b]This new mechanic lets you strategize and manage countdowns!
[/b][/h3]Use certain cards, relics, and perks to alter or delay enemy special moves. Plan your moves carefully!
(Fun Fact: The card [b]Taming Technique[/b] was designed by one of our interns!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/d3140734a9b2d50d4d1c3c9897532366722c8084.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/b8b24e401cf430f77130a804ebb11a01b8bd7a6c.png[/img]

[h2]Expanded Blacksmith Section 🔨[/h2]
We’ve revamped the Blacksmith to make navigating Merge, Forge, and Fuse services easier for players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/ce2c5f2fcccca7cb7718676550c23c7db8a01af6.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog#13 Cooking Demo...
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been a while, but we've been working tirelessly on our public demo, and before we bid farewell to this year, we wanted to share our progress! ːdazed_yetiː

Based on your invaluable feedback, we've implemented a ton of changes in the game.
This includes both design and UX improvements!

[h2]🔥 Now, let's dive into the updates:[/h2]

[h3]Card Merging: You can now merge similar cards! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/de4acd1408e523f5c70384bf5868e73baa89d07d.png[/img]
If you have duplicate cards, you can combine them to unlock even more powerful effects. This upgraded version is called the '+' version. Each card's effect varies, and we encourage you to discover all of them because some can be really powerful!

[h3]Gem Upgrades: Each card can now have a maximum of 1 gem upgrade.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/63fd9abec7a3d6cffb0f33f57e32124172fa3e4d.png[/img]
We recognize that cards with two gem upgrades can become overly powerful, so we've now limited upgrades to one gem per card. However, if you merge two cards, each with a gem, the resulting merged card will have two gems! Isn't that cool? 💎

[i]But take note: we've implemented new merging price conditions. The cost for each card now varies depending on its rarity, the gems attached, and other factors. So, make sure you have enough resources![/i]

[h3]New Roguelite Progression: Experience Points and Town Points.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/3d9d94c723b2cec44abfb44bd545aa33ec0c7ccd.png[/img]
Our previous pre-demo roguelite progression isn't that impactful.
So, we've split it into two types: Experience Points and Town Points.

[list]
[*] [b]Experience Points[/b]: Unlock new cards and relics immediately upon collecting enough points. 
[*] [b]Town Points[/b]: Use these to purchase upgrades in town, which can significantly change your playstyle. If you're fond of the 'Merge' system, you can choose to upgrade the Blacksmith. Alternatively, if gems are more your style, the 'Alchemist' is also available. Additionally, if you're looking to better manage your resources, there are upgrades available for that as well.
[/list]
[h2]That's it for now...[/h2]
**Spoiler: Undead Slime**
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/6dd98a6339a30cda540329a7cbdb1cd5896bc8ad.gif[/img]

There are many more changes we've made, but let's save some surprises for later.
We think the Demo should be available by the end of February or March so stay tuned!

And like always we'll have LIVE TESTER (Should be around the beginning of February!)
Thank you for your incredible support! ːheart_eyes_yetiː
The Northwind team, Barking Kitten Interactive. 🐾

[b]Players hate Boss Act 1:[/b] most players lose the game and don't get to experience the town system.

[h2]What will be fix/change?[/h2]

[b]According to the feedback from our Alpha Test. (List that needs fixing).
[/b][list]
[*] Control needs to be smoother. (Throw, click, slide, cancel, etc.)
[*] A lot of UX/UI.
[*] The tutorial is unfriendly, and some players are still confused about the game.
[*] Monster power spike and difficulty is a big problem.
[*] Cards synergy can be better.
[*] Aura-type monsters are annoying.
[*] Request/Need a lot of visual feedback, icons, animation, etc.
[/list][b]So, after a long discussion, here are things we can confirm.[/b]
[list]
[*] Friendlier Tutorial and UX/UI.
[*] Control will be smoother.
[*] Add more impactful relics and gems.
[*] Adjust randomness in the map node and more unique Events.
[*] Roguelite progressions will be added.
[*] Fight animations, VFX, and animation feedback will be added.
[*] Spoiler: Big changes in the ITEM system (Too STS at the moment, we'll make it Northwind style).
[*] [b]And many more! I don't want to spoil all the goods, so see for yourself in our Demo! ːsteammockingː[/b]
[/list]
[h2]Demo and Early Access launch date.[/h2]
We need to move our launch date. We initially expected to launch our game around June, but after careful consideration... the game won't be up to our standard, or at least we believe you won't be happy with that quality.

[list]
[b][*] The Demo should be available in August.
[*] Early Access... probably Q4. (We'll announce officially again when the date is near.)[/b][/list]Unfortunately, we need to move the date, but we believe it's the best for the game. ːcrying_yetiː

[h2]Message from the Developers.[/h2]
Some players wrote us essays, some played the game for over 10Hrs+, and some DM me regularly with all the things they find frustrating.

Thank you for your time and feedback; we read every single word.
This means so much to us; we feel Northwind has received so much love and care.
We are thankful, humbled, and appreciate all the time and effort you've given us. 
Your words help us make a better version of Northwind. We will work hard not to disappoint all of you.

Thank you for reading, have a great day! ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Cards
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

This month we would love to cover one-two features that make us unique as a roguelite deckbuilding card game.

[h2]Combat System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/69cea4ed652e1b43f30ae9def54b388f512868b0.gif[/img]

[b]To kill or damage an enemy in our game, you will need to [b]overpower[/b] your enemy attack point.[/b]

[u]In this scenario, this bird has 12 attack points.[/u]
[b][i]Case 1[/i][/b] = After you play all your cards this turn, you have a total of “19” attack points.
When battle the bird will take 7 damage points. (19-12 = 7)
[b][i]Case 2[/i][/b] = After playing all your cards, you end up with “2” attack points.
When battle you will take 10 damage points. (2-12 = -10)

Yep! In this game, we count all of your attack points and compare them to your enemy's.
Whoever has fewer attack points will take that damage.
[b]So it'll either be you or your opponent who will take the damage. You can even beat the game unscratched if you can.[/b] ːsteammockingː

[h2]Cards[/h2]
Last time we talked about the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1476400/view/3077641582871487173]"Move"[/url] card, mainly used for generating high damage points, now let's talk about "Skill" and "Equipment" cards.

[b]Skill Cards[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/05f8821d1aafeb971fc977162cb08e19394bfb5e.png[/img]
It doesn't generate attack points but instead provides you utility in combat.
Picking the right card will strengthen your overall combos and synergy.ːsteamhappyː

[b]Equipment Cards[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/65d485997f07a6474f444e7651dc40868da94c8f.png[/img]
You can play equipment cards when your character level meets its costs. You will gain the card's ability until the battle ends unless you encounter the "Destroy" keyword and when destroyed your card will return to your discard pile. You can still play it again when drawn.

Do not worry about leveling up your character. It is worthwhile and easier than you think.

[u][b]FAQ about our Level and Action points.[/b][/u]

[i]What benefits do you get when leveling up?[/i]
- Your "Move" card generates more attack points.
- You can play the "Equipment" card.
- Some card abilities will also be upgraded after you reach a specific level

[i]Will the level up last forever?[/i]
- Nope! Each time you encounter a new monster your level will reset to level 1.

[i]How to level up your character?[/i]
- It costs 5 Action points to level up.

[i]How do you gain action points?[/i]
- Relics or cards. You earn your action points from cards you draw or relics you own. You may earn 0-100 action points in one turn, wholly depending on how you build your deck and the relics you pick.
- You get to keep all your action points, it won't disappear at the end of the turn.

[h2]This cover some concept/ideas of our game design.
[/h2]Hopefully, you will look forward to our gameplay and our trailer.
Next time we'll cover our world Setting and theme.
Thank you for reading, and as always have a wonderful day. ːsteamthumbsupː

From joining our discord, wishlist to following our steam page. ːsteamhappyː

So what happened within the three weeks?

[h2]Cards[/h2]
There are three types of cards. Features our first type, "Move" cards, for generating damage output. One of the main distinctive features in our game is the three diamond shapes, which represent a damage output. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/9700533eb834789b8c4b3f63543b7eb9bfb0a718.png[/img]
The first diamond represents your current damage output.
The second diamond will only be unlocked when you level up your character to level 2, and the third diamond damage output will be unlocked when you reach level 3.

[u][b]Reddit peeps questions[/b][/u]

[i]How to level up your character?[/i]
[b]- It costs 5 Action points to level up.[/b] So instead of using your action points on playing cards, you can choose to level up your mercenary.

[i]Will the level up last forever?[/i]
[i][b]- Nope![/b][/i] Each time you encounter a new monster your level will reset to level 1.

[i]How do you gain action points?[/i]
[i][b]- Relics or cards.[/b][/i] Unlike any deck builder, you earn your action points from cards you draw or relics you own. You may earn 0-10 action points in one turn, wholly depending on how you build your deck and the relics you pick.

Btw, you get to keep all your action points, it won't disappear at the end of the turn in our game.
